_note: Initial import of the data source registry: the 75 sources the hourly build collected before the Admin → Data sources page existed. Once supabase/schema.sql has been run, the registry in the database is the configuration and this file is used only if the database has never been set up. Change sources on the Admin page, not here. Ids are permanent, so a source keeps its history when its address changes. News search addresses are built from settings.query (scripts and pages share public/sources-lib.js).
